advancements.hha_arius.seal.title: The Seal
advancements.hha_arius.takt_break.descri: Break the rhythm of Arius and Solvane

death.attack.hha_arius.pressure: %1$s was crushed by a pressure front
death.attack.hha_arius.pressure.player: %1$s was crushed by a pressure front
hha_arius.adapt.arrows: Arius has adjusted to your arrows.
hha_arius.adapt.back: Arius now expects attacks from behind.
hha_arius.bar.arius_heir: Arius, Heir of the White Dragon
hha_arius.bar.nivaris: Solvane, Heart of the White Dragon
hha_arius.blueprint.no_server: The server does not have HHA Arius.
hha_arius.blueprint.none: No blueprints found. Put .litematic files into %s.
hha_arius.blueprint.ready: "%s": %s blocks, about %s resonance. The outline stands in front of you – /ariusc schematic confirm to build, cancel to discard.
hha_arius.cine.chase.sub: Run. Over the mountains, up to the summit.
hha_arius.cine.summit.sub: No storm. No dragon. Only him.
hha_arius.client.shake_off: Camera jolt on heavy hits: off
hha_arius.client.shake_on: Camera jolt on heavy hits: on
hha_arius.client.snow: Snowstorm rendering: %s (auto = world, plus screen layer with a shader pack)
hha_arius.counter.warn_sub: Counter stance: wait until the red fades
hha_arius.duo.cross_cut.sub: A pincer from both sides – the golden fields are safe
hha_arius.duo.dragon_ride.sub: He rides her dive – stay in the golden lanes
hha_arius.duo.frost_prison.sub: One gap – or face him inside
hha_arius.duo.gale_cleave.sub: Her storm throws you onto his blade
hha_arius.duo.harmony.sub: After his blade comes her bite: step aside
hha_arius.duo.twin_fang.sub: Dodge him – and she is already there
hha_arius.feat.all_out.sub: Blades, breath, moons, horizon and the hole
hha_arius.feat.blade_intent.sub: His will fights beside him – three hits break an echo
hha_arius.feat.last_clash.sub: Cross his blade together – on the flash
hha_arius.feat.last_horizon.sub: One cut across the whole summit – only the gold remains
hha_arius.feat.silence.sub: When the blade flashes gold: sneak, block or strike
hha_arius.feat.storm_breaks.sub: Step aside from his three cuts, then strike
hha_arius.feat.white_hole.sub: It pushes – find the lee or the eye
hha_arius.feat.white_hole_twist.sub: Stand in the light shards and hurl them into the core
hha_arius.feat.white_horizon.sub: A cut that splits a mountain – and nothing else
hha_arius.hint.downed: Solvane crashed into her own ice ridge. Her head is on the ground!
hha_arius.hint.dragon_down: Solvane is down. Arius fights on alone.
hha_arius.hint.slam_open: Solvane slammed into the ground and is dazed – strike now!
hha_arius.hint.takt_break: Rhythm broken! The partner is open.
hha_arius.hint.white_hole: The pressure drives you out: shelter in the golden lee – or fight through to him!
hha_arius.hint.white_hole_backlash: The energy crashes back on him!
hha_arius.hint.white_hole_break: His focus breaks! The hole collapses.
hha_arius.hint.white_hole_erupt: Eruption! Into the lee or into the eye!
hha_arius.hint.white_hole_feed: Light shards in the core: %s of %s. Stay in a golden circle!
hha_arius.hint.winter_roar: Winter's Wrath! Get into the golden eye of the storm – or hit her throat.
hha_arius.hunt.cave.crawl: The passage narrows. Icicles hang above you.
hha_arius.hunt.cave.dark: Darkness. Only the ice in the veins glows.
hha_arius.hunt.cave.lake: Beneath the dome lies a frozen lake.
hha_arius.hunt.cave.wind: The storm howls through the rock.
hha_arius.hunt.collapse: The bridge is snapping behind you – run!
hha_arius.hunt.fill: Her breath fills the cave – run!
hha_arius.hunt.rumble: The mountain rumbles – the passage is about to collapse!
hha_arius.hunt.sealed: Rubble blocks the passage – take the narrow side tunnel!
hha_arius.keys.conflict: Arius: the key %s is bound to "%s" and also to "%s". Rebind one of them under Options → Controls, otherwise the press may not arrive.
hha_arius.keys.gauntlets_melee: Melee: combos are left/right clicks in order (e.g. L L R) · sneak + right-click parry · [%s] magic · [%s] spell wheel
hha_arius.keys.solvane: Solvane: hold [%s] to charge Clear Cut, release to cut (sneak: horizontal)
hha_arius.keys.unbound: Arius: "%s" is not bound. Bind it under Options → Controls → HHA, otherwise the spell wheel, mode switch or Clear Cut are missing.
hha_arius.line.again.2: Another seal. You people don't learn.
hha_arius.line.defeat: Go home. Take the seal with you. It doesn't belong here.
hha_arius.line.dragon.carry: Solvane. Take them to your aerie.
hha_arius.line.dragon.name: Solvane.
hha_arius.line.dragon.polite: Dragon first, blade second. Be polite.
hha_arius.line.dragon.release: Solvane. Show them what you were.
hha_arius.line.dragon.wake: Hear that? That is not the wind.
hha_arius.line.echo: Just one part. Then we're done.
hha_arius.line.end.heaven: That armour's from the marble mountain, isn't it? I hope they paid you well.
hha_arius.line.end.hell: Black netherite with soulfire. I'd rather not ask where from.
hha_arius.line.end.nivaris: She won't speak to me for a week now.
hha_arius.line.end.take: Take this. And throw the next seal into the sea.
hha_arius.line.end.weapon: You're not a weapon. A weapon wouldn't have stopped when it was over.
hha_arius.line.finale: No more storm. Just you and me.
hha_arius.line.finale.silence: No more storm. Only the blade.
hha_arius.line.home.astoria: Where I come from there's a village called Eirholm. This sanctum doesn't belong there. It belongs to the blade.
hha_arius.line.home.far: Astoria is farther than your maps go. I checked.
hha_arius.line.intro.reason: A heart sleeps beneath this ice. Every seal wakes it.
hha_arius.line.intro.seal: A White Throne seal. This far from home.
hha_arius.line.intro.seas: I crossed three seas to be rid of them.
hha_arius.line.intro.test: Put it down. … No? Then show me what you carry it for.
hha_arius.line.rumor.gate: They told me about a black gate with a red sky behind it, and a host who receives everyone. I stayed up here.
hha_arius.line.rumor.messenger: A messenger with wings on his sandals passed me twice. He never stopped. I don't think he does.
hha_arius.line.rumor.olympus: On my way here there was a temple on a marble mountain. Four stones wanted gifts from me. All I had was snow.
hha_arius.msg.art.bridge_dims: Bridge: length %s · width %s (scroll; sneak + scroll: width)
hha_arius.msg.bank_full_bar: Your resonance bar is already full.
hha_arius.msg.blueprint_arena: You cannot build inside the arena.
hha_arius.msg.blueprint_busy: A blueprint is already being built.
hha_arius.msg.blueprint_done: Blueprint done: %s blocks placed, %s resonance refunded.
hha_arius.msg.blueprint_empty: Nothing to build (all forbidden or out of reach).
hha_arius.msg.blueprint_no_mana: Not enough resonance in the Frost Reservoir: %s needed, %s stored.
hha_arius.msg.busy: You're already part of an encounter.
hha_arius.msg.chase: He's beside himself! Follow the lantern path over the three mountains and their bridges up to the Gate of the Blade – the hunt ends at the summit.
hha_arius.msg.clash_miss: Too late – the draw goes through.
hha_arius.msg.defeat: The snow settles. The seal is still in your pocket.
hha_arius.msg.fixed: Arius has his eyes on you.
hha_arius.msg.forming: The Sanctum of the White Blade is taking shape …
hha_arius.msg.forming_pct: The Sanctum of the White Blade is taking shape … %s %%
hha_arius.msg.full: Every sanctum is in use right now. Try again in a moment.
hha_arius.msg.inbox: %s items from the Sanctum are still waiting for you. They move into your inventory as soon as there is room.
hha_arius.msg.ko: You're knocked out and keep everything. You rejoin in the next part.
hha_arius.msg.latejoin: The fight is already running. You join in the next part.
hha_arius.msg.need_resonance: Not enough Frost Resonance (%s needed, %s held)
hha_arius.msg.no_dimension: The Sanctum of the White Blade is missing (data pack not loaded).
hha_arius.msg.path_storm: The storm throws you back onto the path.
hha_arius.msg.punish_ally: %s is caught – hit Arius hard to free them!
hha_arius.msg.punished: Parried! He won't let you go…
hha_arius.msg.ride_fall: You lose your grip and fall – the stream of light catches you.
hha_arius.msg.ride_hit_arch: The rock tears you off her back, you're down to one hand!
hha_arius.msg.ride_hit_fangs: The ice fangs catch your legs, one hand slips!
hha_arius.msg.ride_hit_ice: The ice bursts your grip, you're down to one hand!
hha_arius.msg.ride_hit_needle: The needle slams you aside, one hand slips!
hha_arius.msg.ride_recover: You get both hands back on the spike!
hha_arius.msg.ride_slip: One hand slips off the spike! Nail one dodge to recover your grip.
hha_arius.msg.ride_slip_again: You slam against her scales – hold on!
hha_arius.msg.seal_in_fight: You are already in the Sanctum.
hha_arius.msg.seal_missing: The seal is gone. The storm settles.
hha_arius.msg.seal_not_cold: The seal stays silent. It is not cold enough here.
hha_arius.msg.sent_home: The sanctum is quiet. You're back outside.
hha_arius.msg.test_on: Test mode on: infinite Frost Resonance, minimal cooldowns, every technique usable anywhere.
hha_arius.msg.watching: He only watches. A white boundary lies between you.
hha_arius.portal.already_lit: This gate is already burning, the seal is inside it.
hha_arius.portal.explore: You are still in Eirholm. The return gates on the summit and by the field take you home.
hha_arius.portal.inside: In Eirholm the seal opens no gate.
hha_arius.portal.no_frame: No complete frame of Rime Gate Stone (inside 2–21 wide, 3–21 tall).
hha_arius.portal.stay: Eirholm falls silent. Look around as long as you like – the return gates on the summit and by the field take you back to where you set out. Your spoils wait there.
hha_arius.qte.hold_dive: She drops into a sheer dive – hold on!
hha_arius.qte.hold_on: She tears straight up – hold on to the spike!
hha_arius.qte.hold_storm: The storm is tearing at you – cling on!
hha_arius.qte.hold_turn: She banks hard into the turn – don't let go!
hha_arius.qte.how.mash: Press %s as fast as you can: %s / %s
hha_arius.qte.r_arch: A rock arch right above her back: press yourself flat!
hha_arius.qte.r_arch_ice: Icicles at head height: press yourself flat!
hha_arius.qte.r_fangs: Ice fangs at leg height: pull your legs up!
hha_arius.qte.r_ice: The spray is freezing your hands: hack the ice off!
hha_arius.qte.r_needle_left: Rock needle on the left: swing your legs right!
hha_arius.qte.r_needle_right: Rock needle on the right: swing your legs left!
hha_arius.qte.r_regrip: You're hanging by one hand: grab back on!
hha_arius.qte.ride_arch: A rock arch is rushing at you – duck!
hha_arius.qte.ride_arch_ice: An ice arch in the storm – head down!
hha_arius.qte.ride_brace: Your grip is slipping – grab on with your other hand!
hha_arius.qte.ride_ice: Ice is growing over your hands – hack it off!
hha_arius.qte.ride_jump: Ice shards whip across her back – jump over them!
hha_arius.qte.ride_ridge: An ice ridge dead ahead – pull yourself up!
hha_arius.ride.grip_one: Grip: ONE hand – nail 1 QTE to grab back on with both hands!
hha_arius.scene.cut_after: Only now do you hear the cut.
hha_arius.scene.dragon: One eye gold, one ice-blue. Like his.
hha_arius.scene.lift: Solvane carries you out into the highland.
hha_arius.scene.transform: The armour falls apart into frost. Underneath, he wears white.
hha_arius.scene.white_hole: A light that does not pull. It pushes.
hha_arius.spell.blade_storm.desc: Five wind blades fan out and seek the nearest targets ahead (22 blocks), 5 damage each · 6 s
hha_arius.spell.frost_field.desc: Frost field (radius 4) for 5 s: heavy slow, biting cold (damage + frost buildup); ice thorns erupt at the end · 10 s
hha_arius.spell.frost_shards.desc: Three ice shards in a fan (14 blocks), 3 damage each, 1.5 s slow · 1 s
hha_arius.spell.full_pot.desc: 60 s Strength II, Speed II, Fire Resistance; 15 s Regeneration II · 70 resonance · 90 s
hha_arius.spell.gale.desc: Hold to charge (up to 1.2 s): wind cone 7 blocks, 3 damage, strong knockback, sweeps projectiles away · 4 s
hha_arius.spell.glacier_lance.desc: Hold to charge (up to 1.8 s): giant ice spear (30 blocks), pierces everything, 8–18 damage, bursts into a frost explosion · 7 s
hha_arius.spell.ice_armor.desc: Ice shell for 8 s: absorbs 3 hearts of damage, then shatters · 20 s
hha_arius.spell.ice_prison.desc: Locks the targeted enemy in a cage of frost for 3.5 s, heavy slow, big frost buildup · 15 s
hha_arius.spell.ice_wall.desc: Aim and place: 5 × 3 wall of crystal ice, lasts 10 s · 8 s
hha_arius.spell.tank_mode.desc: 20 s Turtle Master: Resistance IV, Slowness IV · 60 resonance · 60 s
hha_arius.spell.tornado.desc: Travelling tornado (5 s): pulls enemies in and lifts them, 1.5 damage every 0.5 s, shreds projectiles · 11 s
hha_arius.spell.wind_blade.desc: Wind crescent straight ahead (16 blocks), 5 damage, pierces one target · 0.75 s
hha_arius.spell.wind_leap.desc: Leap up and forward; your next fall deals no damage · 2 s
hha_arius.spell.wind_pull.desc: Pull within 10 blocks: draws in items and experience, puts out fire · 2 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_bridge.desc: Arch bridge of Yang light straight ahead: scroll = length (4–50), sneak + scroll = width (3–9); pillars down to the ground, cost grows with size, lasts 8 s · 5 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_glide.desc: Glide on a disc of light (up to 8 s, 4/s), steer with your view, sneak to step off · 10 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_orb.desc: Hold to charge (up to 1.5 s): orb of light (24 blocks), 4–10 damage, blooms on impact · 1.5 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_platform.desc: Aim and place: 3 × 3 light platform, lasts 15 s, up to 3 at once · 1.5 s
hha_arius.spell.yang_shield.desc: Hold (up to 5 s): light shield in front, −60 % damage, costs 8/s plus per hit · 3 s
hha_arius.stance.flow: Arius shifts into the flowing stance – chains and feints.
hha_arius.stance.heaven: Heaven stance! Heavy, delayed blows from above.
hha_arius.stance.sheath: Sheath stance – don't attack blindly, he counters.
hha_arius.wheel.title: Spell wheel
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore1: Melee: combos from left and right clicks in order, sneak + right-click parry (base damage %s)
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore2: Magic: right-click casts the selected technique, left-click cancels · hold Ability 4: spell wheel (techniques, potions on top)
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore3: Ability 5: melee ↔ magic · schools: Wind (movement, crescent), Ice (control, walls), Yang (light, bridges)
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore4: A pair, worn in the main hand. The off hand rests.
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore5: Chain: jab · cross · hook · uppercut (launches) – kick after the hook = spin kick, after the uppercut = axe kick with a frost wave
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore6: Dryleaf arts: sprint + attack flying kick · sprint + right-click palm blast · sneak + attack flurry · airborne: attack dive kick, right-click whirlwind kick
item.hha_arius.arius_gauntlets.lore7: Combos: LLR Storm Chain · LLLL Glacier Fist · LLLR Glacier Breaker · LRL Heartbreaker · LRR Avalanche · RRR Dragon Tail · RLR Wind Lotus · RLL Hailstorm
item.hha_arius.eirholm.lore.set: Arius armour · Full set: White Hole, faster recharge, +25 % resonance
item.hha_arius.eirholm_boots.lore1: Passive: powder snow holds you, falls up to 2.5 hearts of damage are caught
item.hha_arius.eirholm_boots.lore2: Recharges passively: %s/s, out of combat +%s/s (full set +%s/s)
item.hha_arius.eirholm_chestplate.lore1: Ability 1 (G) – Dragon Breath: %s resonance, 1.5 s frost cone ahead (%s blocks), %s damage every 0.15 s
item.hha_arius.eirholm_chestplate.lore2: Heavily slows and freezes targets · Cooldown %s s
item.hha_arius.eirholm_chestplate.lore3: Passive – Frost Plate: whoever hits you in melee is slowed for 1 s (per attacker every 3 s)
item.hha_arius.eirholm_helmet.lore1: Passive: no freezing in powder snow and cold
item.hha_arius.eirholm_helmet.lore2: Full set, Ability 3 (U) – White Hole: uses all resonance (full), core up to %s blocks ahead, repels, %s damage on eruption
item.hha_arius.eirholm_helmet.lore3: Pulls light enemies into the core, bosses stay put · Cooldown %s s
item.hha_arius.eirholm_leggings.lore1: Ability 2 (H) – Dragon Tail: %s resonance, Solvane's ghostly tail lashes once all around you · Cooldown %s s
item.hha_arius.eirholm_leggings.lore2: Radius %s, %s damage per target, flings away, slows and freezes; no melee damage meanwhile
item.hha_arius.eirholm_seal.lore1: Forged after a method of the White Throne.
item.hha_arius.eirholm_seal.lore2: Cold biomes only. %s s of blizzard, then into the Sanctum of the White Blade
item.hha_arius.frost_bank.lore1: Stores resonance: every creature you kill and any overflow of your bar
item.hha_arius.frost_bank.lore2: Covers missing resonance automatically · right-click fills the bar · pays for Litematica blueprints
item.hha_arius.heartfrost.lore1: Ice from the heart vault. It does not melt.
item.hha_arius.nivaris_wingscale.lore1: Wing Beat: %s up, %s forward, %s s Slow Falling
item.hha_arius.nivaris_wingscale.lore2: Landing: a snow gust pushes enemies back · Cooldown %s s
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore0: Replica of the blade forged from the heart of an ancient white dragon.
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore1: Clear Edge: only fully charged swings count, +%s frost damage
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore2: Every %s. full hit on the same target shatters: +%s damage and a short slow
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore3: Right-click – Counter Stance (%s s): one melee hit is deflected and countered · Cooldown %s s / %s s
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore4: Hold Ability 4 – Clear Cut: %s resonance, %s–%s damage (full after 1.5 s) · Cooldown %s s
item.hha_arius.solvane.lore5: Release to cut a plane (sneak = horizontal), splits blocks up to hardness %s (at most %s)
